description: Medicare-subsidised GP, allied health and specialist health care across local areas is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW). The Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW) provides downloadable datasets covering the use of non-hospital Medicare-subsidised services, such as GP, allied health, specialist, diagnostic imaging, and nursing and Aboriginal health workers. The data are presented at national and state and territory levels, and for Primary Health Network (PHN) regions and Statistical Area Level 3 (SA3). Coverage is Australia, 2013 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
